outcome: Newborn characteristics (birth weight, length, head circumference, APGAR score)
cohort: 437 women who gave birth vaginally at a hospital in Brasília between January and June 2019.
finding: The study characterized the profile of women who had vaginal births, finding varied characteristics and highlighting the need for continued improvement in obstetric practices.
gest_age: Mentioned but not specified for all participants (25.63% were 39 weeks pregnant)
